scope: corporate and workforce full source editions
method: Each PDF page inspected individually as a 120 dpi PNG at readable resolution. Previously inspected pages were carried forward only when rendered PNG bytes were identical; every changed page was reinspected. Each source HTML inspected in 1280x1000 desktop and 390x1000 mobile viewport screenshots; complete-document overflow and image checks are separate automated checks. Six wide mobile tables were additionally inspected at both horizontal endpoints. Full-height screenshots are retained as supplementary captures, not a claim of manual inspection of every scroll position.

corrections.finding: Formation record had a one-word final page; 2022 minutes began page 2 with one orphaned word.
corrections.resolution: Renderer keeps ordinary source paragraphs intact; complete source sections now appear together. Reinspected affected pages.

corrections.finding: Short IDs/dates and ordinary table labels fragmented within words; industrial leadership job titles wrapped poorly.
corrections.resolution: Renderer added minimum cell widths, normal word wrapping and wider leadership first column. Reinspected every changed PDF page.

corrections.finding: Five-column mobile tables squeezed words into unreadable fragments despite no global overflow.
corrections.resolution: Renderer uses minimum 8em mobile cells in horizontally scrollable tables. Both endpoints of six wide tables inspected; rightmost columns accessible.

corrections.finding: Initial non-source provenance created a print-only tail page.
corrections.resolution: Edition provenance retained in HTML/manifest, hidden in print; source prose preserved.

limitations: This is publication QA, not approval of new designs or verification of execution of synthetic legal instruments.
Source statuses, summaries, historical wording and unresolved instruments remain as documented in SOURCE_AUDIT.md.
Short final pages containing complete source sections are retained rather than deleting or compressing source text.
